cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# Opt-in ESP-IDF component; do not edit the parent/shared component CMake.
if(COMMAND idf_component_register)
    idf_component_register(SRCS "src/microsd_slot_io.cpp"
        INCLUDE_DIRS "include" "../include")
else()
    project(orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd LANGUAGES CXX)
    add_library(orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd STATIC src/microsd_slot_io.cpp)
    target_include_directories(orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd PUBLIC
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include")
    target_compile_features(orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()
    option(ORC_DISCOVERY_SD_SANITIZE "ASan + UBSan for host tests" OFF)
    if(ORC_DISCOVERY_SD_SANITIZE)
        if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Sanitizers require GCC or Clang")
        endif()
        target_compile_options(orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
        target_link_options(orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
    endif()
    if(UNIX)
        enable_testing()
        add_executable(micro_sd_slot_io_tests tests/micro_sd_slot_io_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(micro_sd_slot_io_tests PRIVATE orcsdr_discovery_micro_sd)
        target_compile_options(micro_sd_slot_io_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
        add_test(NAME micro_sd_slot_io_tests COMMAND micro_sd_slot_io_tests)
    endif()
endif()
